# outlier-and-noise

Twelve RTX 3090 asks (£600 to £710), one far above (£2,000) and one the noise filter flags. The index
leaves the £2,000 ask out as an outlier and the noise listing out altogether. The outlier is still
positioned against the 12 counted asks: above all of them, rank 13, 100%. The noise listing gets no
position: it is left out for its own reason, not the group's.
